content: Financial institutions use the concept of “Value at risk” to measure the expected volatility of their portfolios. The widespread econometric model for volatility forecasting is the Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) BIBREF32 , BIBREF33 . Previous research shows that the GARCH(1,1) model is hard to beat. For example, BIBREF34 compared GARCH(1,1) with 330 different econometric volatility models showing that they are not significantly better than GARCH(1,1).
